name: MeshGraph MeSH search
short_description: Substring MeSH descriptor search over a YottaDB citation index. Read-only.
description: Read-only HTTP MCP server exposing mesh_search (substring MeSH name search over 31k descriptors, ui+name hits, truncated flag) and mesh_get (descriptor name by UI, e.g. D009157). Backed by MeshGraph, a YottaDB biomedical citation index. No auth; no writes.
